name: print-ii-ifce-cedro-horarios-professores

scripts.install-all: npm install && cd client && npm install && cd ../server && npm install
scripts.migrate: cd server && npx sequelize-cli db:migrate && echo Migration
scripts.migrate-seeds: cd server && npx sequelize-cli db:migrate && npx sequelize-cli db:seed:all && echo Migration + seeds
scripts.undo: cd server && npx sequelize-cli db:migrate:undo:all && echo banco reiniciado

author: André Casimiro da Silva, Daniel Teixeira da Silva, João Alberto Almeida de Deus, Vicencya Nayara e Raimundo Gabriel Pereira Ferreira.
description: Sistema de Organização dos horários dos professores do IFCE campus Cedro
